recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-36006 unless a future work group decision changes bdl-8 semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction asking for the Bundle.entry fullUrl invariant to be guarded so entries without fullUrl do not fail the version-specific-reference check.
initial_application: Commit 79442526caf5645dc6e1b867d66befaa67fb87d5, "FHIR-36006 - Fixed bdl-8", changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml from fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not() to fullUrl.exists() implies fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not(). A prior all-branch pickaxe hit, 235cb1af4119d6a1da874a29b82889e183b71860 for FHIR-25525, made the same expression change on another history path, but the current branch's direct application is 79442526ca.
additional_context: The Jira title says bld-9, but the affected current source invariant is Bundle constraint bdl-8 on Bundle.entry. source/fhir.ini lists Bundle as an active normative infrastructure resource with code bdl, so the StructureDefinition is in build scope. The referenced Zulip thread confirms the missing-fullUrl problem and the preference for the implies expression; Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The worker and combined branches already contain the corrected bdl-8 expression, and source search found no remaining bare fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not() occurrence in active source.
